content.short: Splinterlands is a digital trading card game for Web3 where players can collect, trade, and battle.
content.description: Splinterlands is a digital trading card game built on the Hive blockchain. Players duel in strategic matches using collectible NFT cards, each card existing as an on-chain asset with provable rarity. Because these cards are NFTs, they can be traded transparently on decentralized marketplaces, enabling verifiable scarcity and value across the ecosystem. The rapid growth and adoption of Splinterlands has resulted in the formation of the Splinterlands DAO, an organization committed to the continued expansion of the Splinterlands ecosystem.
